reason: I run thin-margin restaurants and I have never heard of Sora. It is a brand-new company with no restaurant live yet, and I am being asked to pay R699 a month for it before anyone has proven it works in a real kitchen.
objection: Staff still ring every order up on the POS, so this looks like double work on a Friday night, and I am not paying a monthly fee for a screen that adds a step.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three existing pilot restaurants that I can call, showing fewer order errors or faster table turns, plus a free or cancellable trial period on my busiest nights.
